title: Fake Loan Offer Scams — Instant Approval, No Documents
text: Fake loan scams target people who urgently need credit — particularly those with low credit scores or who have been rejected by banks. They advertise via SMS, WhatsApp, and social media with promises of 'instant approval', 'zero documents', 'guaranteed sanction', or 'no CIBIL check'. Warning signs: (1) Processing fee demanded upfront — 'Pay Rs 999 to disburse your Rs 2 lakh loan.' Legitimate lenders deduct processing fees from the disbursed amount or charge after approval; they never ask for cash/UPI upfront. (2) The lender has no RBI registration — all legitimate NBFCs and banks must be registered with RBI. Check the RBI's list of registered entities at rbi.org.in. (3) Personal information demanded before any formal process — Aadhaar, PAN, bank account number, and password collected via WhatsApp or unofficial forms. (4) The 'loan' disbursement keeps getting delayed and more fees are demanded. What to do: Never pay any upfront fee for a loan. Verify the lender's RBI registration. Apply only through bank branches, official websites, or RBI-registered NBFCs. Report fake loan apps and messages at cybercrime.gov.in.
